blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senators on Monday called for an inquiry into delayed allowances for national athletes after Alas Pilipinas men’s captain Bryan Bagunas said some players have gone without them since July and had to borrow money to get to training. In a manifestation during session, Sen. Joel Villanueva said the Senate should determine whether support from national sports associations is reaching athletes when they need it. “We are hearing that some national athletes have had no allowance since July. No allowance since July. And have had to borrow money just to attend practice,” Villanueva said. “The gap deserves an explanation.” […]...
